messages:
luca: Quick sync — partner ask: can we get a short checklist of integration blockers for H200/MI300/Gaudi before next week's marketplace freeze?
ashley: +1, we need kernel/driver pinning, image tags, and perf knobs documented.
sam: Also timeline for firmware drops from vendors — that affects our CI.
vendor-nvidia-julia: FYI, H200 HW microcode Q2 patch targeted next Tue. Will share SHA and release notes when published.
luca: Great — can you confirm CUDA and driver versions you'll support on the image? We want to bake a marketplace image that passes our smoke tests.
vendor-nvidia-julia: Targeting driver 545.48 and CUDA 12.2 for the H200 image. We'll provide an EOL matrix.
ashley: Noted. Sam, is our kernel compat test matrix ready to include 5.15/6.1/6.4?
sam: We have 5.15 and 6.1 covered. 6.4 is flaky in perf runs; can add but mark as experimental.
vendor-gaudi-ops: For Gaudi2, we recommend users run the rocker image tag `gaudi/runtime:2.3.0-gpu` and kernel >=5.15, plus firmware v1.2.1.
luca: Copy. Can you send the exact docker tag and minimal startup flags? e.g. envs we should set.
vendor-gaudi-ops: Sure — snippet:```
DOCKER_IMAGE=gaudi/runtime:2.3.0-gpu
export GAUDI_ENABLE_FP8=1
export GAUDI_KERNEL_OPT=perf
```
deploy-bot: deploy check triggered by @luca: marketplace-image-smoke -> status: queued.
ashley: Action items: 1) @vendor-nvidia-julia share driver SHA + release notes 2) @vendor-gaudi-ops provide final image tag and envs 3) @sam add 6.4 to experimental matrix 4) @luca draft marketplace preflight doc.
luca: I'll draft the preflight and link to repo: https://git.internal/rw/marketplace-images (will post PR).
vendor-nvidia-julia: Will post the driver artifacts by EOD Monday.
vendor-gaudi-ops: We'll confirm tag and a minimal runbook by tomorrow morning.
sam: I'll start a 6.4 perf run now and share logs in the PR.
ashley: One more ask — embargo windows. We should align release windows so joint announce isn't blocked by late firmware. Any constraints from your side?
vendor-nvidia-julia: Prefer no embargo shorter than 72h after artifact publish — allows partner testing.
vendor-gaudi-ops: We usually ask for 48-72h depending on region.
luca: OK, plan: aim for publish Fri, freeze Tue, announce Wed? I'll map timeline in the PR.
ashley: Sounds good. If anything slips, we fallback to H100-compatible images for early waves.
luca: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a PR and handoff doc.
